big: A buyer pays for a bar and later finds it is not fully pure. Always check the stamp: 999 means 99.9% fine. And remember the costs: dealer premium, storage and bulk.

lines: Can I just buy silver bars?

Yes, but check purity and costs. Investment-grade bars and coins are 999 fine. Hallmarks show purity on articles. Silver takes far more space than gold for the same value, and dealers charge a premium over the market price.

rows: a few per cent above market rate
note: A hallmark on jewellery confirms its fineness.
